sentences.en: So, David, you've been doing some reporting on plans by Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy to cut government to the tune of $2 trillion.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你一直在报道埃隆·马斯克和维韦克·拉马斯瓦米削减2万亿美元政府开支的计划。

sentences.en: You're trying to understand exactly what this effort is and how it would work.
sentences.zh: 你正在试图了解这项工作究竟是什么，以及它将如何运作。

sentences.en: Well, we're talking about this thing called the Department of Government Efficiency.

sentences.en: And a cryptocurrency, apparently.
sentences.zh: 显然，还有一种加密货币。

sentences.en: And a cryptocurrency that's named after the funny dog meme.

sentences.en: Now, there's no thing in the government called the Department of Government Efficiency, but it is something that President Trump has pledged to set up once he takes office.
sentences.zh: 现在，政府里并没有一个叫“政府效率部”的机构，但这是特朗普总统承诺在上任后要设立的部门。

sentences.en: And what they're talking about is kind of a hybrid setup where there would be people outside the government, Vivek Ramaswamy and Elon Musk, these sort of advisors on the outside,
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的是一种混合模式，即会有政府外部的人员，也就是维韦克·拉马斯瓦米和埃隆·马斯克，作为外部顾问，

sentences.en: taking no government salary, holding no government position.
sentences.zh: 不拿政府薪水，也不担任政府职务。

sentences.en: And then a bunch of folks on the inside, people who actually would work for the government.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一群内部人员，也就是真正为政府工作的人。

sentences.en: Musk has described them as sort of committed, smart government, you know, budget cutters.
sentences.zh: 马斯克形容他们是那种坚定、聪明的政府预算削减者。

sentences.en: And together, their goal is pretty massive.
sentences.zh: 他们的共同目标非常宏大。

sentences.en: They talked about, as you said, cutting about $2 trillion from the federal budget.

sentences.en: You know, the numbers like that can get kind of abstract at that size.

sentences.en: But what that really means is about a third of the federal budget they want to cut.
sentences.zh: 但实际上这意味着他们想要削减联邦预算的三分之一。

sentences.en: And they also want to make huge cuts to regulation, to the number of regulations, to the size of the regulatory state.
sentences.zh: 他们还希望对监管进行大规模削减，包括减少监管数量，缩小监管机构的规模。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to note that there is fat in the federal government.
sentences.zh: 现在需要指出的是，联邦政府确实存在臃肿。

sentences.en: There is potentially room to cut it.
sentences.zh: 削减的空间是存在的。

sentences.en: But the thing they're taking on, it's really not just in numbers, but in sort of effort, is going to be a massive task.

sentences.en: So basically, very, very big promises.

sentences.en: But, you know, to be kind of real about this, I think anyone who stood in line that DMV could get behind the idea that a more efficient government, as they say, that they want to

sentences.en: make, makes sense.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你在推特上犯了个错，导致它离线一天，那没什么大不了的，但如果你对空中交通管制员这样做，飞机可能会相撞。

sentences.en: So it seems to me, honestly, like they are still figuring this out themselves, but to

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We're in a situation where a couple of very rich people are sort of putting themselves in the place of identifying what the people want.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，也许他们现在比几个月前更有理由这么做。

sentences.en: Well, there's a few different ways they're going about this.

sentences.en: But the most important thing I think we need to start with is the idea that they want to cut regulations first, federal rules first, and that once you cut rules, then you can
sentences.zh: 它基本上推翻了所谓的“雪佛龙尊重原则”。

sentences.en: start to cut people and spending.
sentences.zh: 我们现在深入到了法律细节，但这很重要。

sentences.en: And the way that they're going to start by cutting rules is using a Supreme Court decision called Loper-Bright.
sentences.zh: 之所以叫雪佛龙，是因为它以80年代雪佛龙公司参与的一起案件命名。

sentences.en: It basically strikes down something called Chevron deference.
sentences.zh: 最高法院在80年代提出的观点是，如果联邦机构制定了一项规则，它采用了国会提出的想法，然后使其更加具体，颁布了一项供人们遵守的规则。

sentences.en: We're deep in the legal weeds here, but this is important.
sentences.zh: 如果有人质疑该规则并说，嘿，这个规则是错误的，或者它不符合国会的意图，法院应该尊重该机构的判断。

sentences.en: So the reason it's called Chevron is it's named after a case in which Chevron was a party back in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 其理念是，该机构拥有专家，他们可能比法院更了解情况，除非规则极其离谱，否则应该尊重该机构的判断。

sentences.en: And the idea that the Supreme Court laid out in the 80s was that if a federal agency makes a rule, it takes an idea that Congress laid out and then sort of makes it more specific,
sentences.zh: 因此，联邦政府的权力在某种程度上存在于那里，因为法院尊重联邦机构对规则的解释。

sentences.en: promulgates a rule for people to abide by.
sentences.zh: 但最高法院在过去几个任期内改变了这一点。

sentences.en: If somebody challenges that rule and says, hey, this rule is wrong or it doesn't comport with what Congress wanted, that the court should defer to the judgment of the agency.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The idea being that the agency has experts that they may know better than the courts, that they should defer to the judgment of the agency unless it's really egregious.
sentences.zh: 所以最高法院废除了这一点。

sentences.en: So the power of the federal government is kind of present there because the court defers to what the federal agency says the rule is.

sentences.en: That if somebody challenges a rule and, you know, in court, that the court should be able to use their own judgment about whether that rule was reasonable or not without going from

sentences.en: And with the help of the folks who work inside government, we're going to identify a whole bunch of rules that we believe are wrong.

sentences.en: Now that we think there's more freedom to challenge federal rules, we're going to find
sentences.zh: 而且你也不需要那么多开支，因为要支付工资的工作人员变少了。

sentences.en: all kinds of federal rules we think are overreaching or don't follow the original intent of Congress or unconstitutional.

sentences.zh: 羊，为了改进羊。

sentences.en: It paid for a sort of contest that rewarded people who were good at shearing sheep, for trips for people in the sheep industry to take, you know, trips around the country.
sentences.zh: 它资助了一种比赛，奖励那些擅长剪羊毛的人，以及供羊业人员去全国各地旅行的费用。

sentences.en: Definitely seems non-essential.
sentences.zh: 这看起来绝对是非必要的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 是的，大约是一百万美元。

sentences.en: So it was sort of like, you know, in theory, the easiest thing to cut.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是，你知道，理论上最容易削减的东西。

sentences.en: And so at the time I was writing about this congressman from Florida, this Republican from
sentences.zh: 当时我正在写一位来自佛罗里达州的国会议员，这位共和党人来自

sentences.en: Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: It was sort of like a Mr. Smith goes to Washington thing, except, you know, the stakes were much, much smaller.
sentences.zh: 这有点像《史密斯先生去华盛顿》，只不过，你知道，赌注要小得多得多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He just wanted to get rid of the National Sheep Industry Improvement Center.
sentences.zh: 他只是想摆脱国家羊业改进中心。

sentences.en: But they were people who really liked the Sheep Improvement Center.
sentences.zh: 但确实有人非常喜欢这个羊业改进中心。

sentences.en: The places that have a lot of sheep, Texas, Montana, they like the money.
sentences.zh: 那些有很多羊的地方，比如德克萨斯州、蒙大拿州，他们喜欢这笔钱。

sentences.en: And why wouldn't, you know, if they're going to be giving out money to everything else, why wouldn't they fight for some of that money to come to this industry they care about in
sentences.zh: 而且为什么不呢，你知道，如果他们要给其他所有东西发钱，为什么他们不争取让其中的一些钱流向他们所在州关心的这个行业呢？

sentences.en: their state?
sentences.zh: 所以这没成功。

sentences.en: And so it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 他失败了。

sentences.en: He failed.
sentences.zh: 他失败了。

sentences.en: So even the like lowest hanging fruit, the thing you think nobody would miss, somebody would miss it.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是那些最容易摘到的果实，你认为没人会怀念的东西，也会有人怀念。

sentences.en: And it didn't go away.
sentences.zh: 而且它并没有消失。

sentences.en: So if you can't cut the Sheep Improvement Center from the federal budget, you're probably not going to be able to cut a big hunk out of, say, Veterans Affairs.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不能从联邦预算中削减羊业改进中心，你可能也无法从退伍军人事务部中削减一大块预算。

sentences.en: No, even the Education Department, you know, that's been something that's been identified as like, well, obviously we've got to cut the Education Department.
sentences.zh: 不，即使是教育部，你知道，那一直被认为是，好吧，显然我们必须削减教育部。

sentences.en: But a lot of what it does is provide grants to schools, school districts and schools all over the country.
sentences.zh: 但它所做的大部分工作是为全国各地的学校、学区和学校提供拨款。

sentences.en: And so there's a lot of people on both sides of the aisle that like it because the people in their district benefit from it and don't want to lose that aid.
sentences.zh: 所以两党中都有很多人喜欢它，因为他们选区的人从中受益，不想失去那笔援助。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I'm not saying this to tell you that it's impossible to cut the budget or the budget shouldn't be cut.
sentences.zh: 所以我说这些并不是要告诉你削减预算是不可能的，或者预算不应该被削减。

sentences.en: I'm just saying that it's not one fight.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，这不仅仅是一场战斗。

sentences.en: It's a million little fights.
sentences.zh: 这是上百万场小规模的战斗。

sentences.en: And if you're going to cut the budget on a broad scale, you have to not only find these programs, but also find and convince or bully the people in your way, the people that are
sentences.zh: 如果你打算大规模削减预算，你不仅要找到这些项目，还要找到并说服或强迫那些阻碍你的人，也就是那些

sentences.en: defending these programs into letting them go.
sentences.zh: 极力维护这些项目的人，让他们放手。

sentences.en: So even the stuff that seems, quote unquote, easy is a lot of work.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使是那些看起来所谓的“容易”的事情，也需要做大量的工作。

sentences.en: And it's presumably much harder if you're an outsider and not an insider who knows how
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你是一个局外人，而不是了解国会运作方式的局内人，

sentences.en: Congress works.
sentences.zh: 那难度想必会大得多。

sentences.en: Absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And that has been the downfall of these outsider efforts in the past is that they don't really understand how Congress works and that they want congressmen to act against their own
sentences.zh: 过去这些局外人努力的失败之处就在于，他们并不真正了解国会是如何运作的，而且他们希望国会议员违背自己的

sentences.en: interests.
sentences.zh: 利益行事。

sentences.en: And it's even more difficult now in a Congress that is so narrowly divided where only a few votes going the other way could doom any idea.
sentences.zh: 而在如今这个分歧严重的国会中，情况就更困难了，只要有几张选票倒戈，任何想法都可能胎死腹中。

sentences.en: So it's very hard to cut government prograMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，削减政府项目非常困难。

sentences.en: You have shown that amply.
sentences.zh: 你已经充分证明了这一点。

sentences.en: But beyond the programs, what about cutting the federal workforce itself?
sentences.zh: 但除了项目之外，削减联邦政府工作人员本身又如何呢？

sentences.en: Well, you first need to know sort of the size of the federal workforce.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你首先需要了解联邦政府工作人员的规模。

sentences.en: It's about 2.3 million civilian employees.
sentences.zh: 大约有230万名文职雇员。

sentences.en: That sounds like a lot, but it hasn't actually changed that much in decades.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很多，但实际上几十年来并没有太大变化。

sentences.en: What has changed is the number of outside contractors that do work for the federal government.
sentences.zh: 真正改变的是为联邦政府工作的外部承包商的数量。

sentences.en: If you come here to D.C., that's what's transformed the D.C.
sentences.zh: 如果你来到华盛顿特区，你会发现这正是改变了华盛顿特区、

sentences.en: area, brought all this wealth to the D.C.
sentences.zh: 为华盛顿特区

sentences.en: area.
sentences.zh: 带来所有这些财富的原因。

sentences.en: So that makes it a hard problem.
sentences.zh: 所以这让问题变得很棘手。

sentences.en: It's not just that you can like shut down this department as hard as that would be.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是你想要关闭某个部门那么简单，尽管那也已经够难了。

sentences.en: If you're going to really shrink the amount of money you spend on federal workers, you're going to have to go through the hard work of auditing contracts, figuring out which ones
sentences.zh: 如果你真的想缩减在联邦工作人员身上的开支，你就必须去做审计合同的艰苦工作，弄清楚哪些

sentences.en: are duplicative, which ones you actually need.
sentences.zh: 是重复的，哪些是你真正需要的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, this is an area where I think Musk and Ramaswamy have not really answered a basic question, which is why are you cutting the federal workforce?
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为马斯克和拉马斯瓦米在这一点上还没有真正回答一个基本问题，那就是：你们为什么要削减联邦工作人员？

sentences.en: Are you doing it because you want to save money?
sentences.zh: 你们这样做是因为想省钱吗？

sentences.en: Is that the goal?
sentences.zh: 这是目标吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to reduce sort of the deep state, the like liberal influence over Washington?
sentences.zh: 你们是想削弱所谓的“深层政府”，即那种对华盛顿的自由派影响力吗？

sentences.en: Are you doing it because you think the government does things that it shouldn't do?
sentences.zh: 你们这样做是因为认为政府在做一些它不该做的事情吗？

sentences.en: This is how far apart those two are.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们两人分歧的程度。

sentences.en: Musk has been calling out on his Twitter account individual government employees who he thinks their jobs are too woke and to look at this person, you know, who works for this
sentences.zh: 马斯克一直在他的推特账号上点名批评个别政府雇员，他认为这些人的工作太“觉醒”（woke）了，并说看看这个人，你知道，他在这个

sentences.en: department on this woke thing where they shouldn't work for the government anymore.
sentences.zh: 部门做这种“觉醒”的事情，他们不应该再为政府工作了。

sentences.en: But firing that person is not going to change the federal budget in any meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 但解雇那个人并不会以任何有意义的方式改变联邦预算。

sentences.en: So you're maybe following your political agenda, but you're not really doing the main work, which is making government more efficient.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能是在追随你的政治议程，但你并没有真正完成主要工作，即提高政府效率。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're not going to cut two trillion dollars firing one person at a time.
sentences.zh: 是的，你不可能通过一个个解雇人来削减两万亿美元。

sentences.en: Ramaswamy, on the other hand, has been sort of like the machete approach to government.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，拉马斯瓦米对政府采取的是一种“大砍刀”式的方法。

sentences.en: He's talked about we should fire everybody who works for the government whose social security number ends in an odd number.
sentences.zh: 他曾说，我们应该解雇所有社会安全号码以奇数结尾的政府雇员。

sentences.en: So just like one of those dramas where everybody just vanishes one day, like, you know, like
sentences.zh: 就像那些每个人突然消失的电视剧一样，你知道，就像

sentences.en: like this, like a rapture, we're going to rapture the government employees and one day only half of them will be there.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，像“被提携”一样，我们要把政府雇员“提携”走，有一天他们中只有一半会留下来。

sentences.en: So there's no sense that we're going to continue delivering the same services.
sentences.zh: 所以，根本没有要继续提供同样服务的概念。

sentences.en: It's just let's cut for cutting's sake.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹就是为了削减而削减。

sentences.en: So until the two of them can get on the same page about what they're cutting and why they're
sentences.zh: 因此，在他们两人就削减什么以及为什么要

sentences.en: cutting, it does leave some questions about their ability to deliver any sort of significant reduction to the federal workforce.
sentences.zh: 削减达成共识之前，他们是否有能力实现联邦工作人员的任何重大裁减，确实令人怀疑。

sentences.en: OK, so bottom line, very difficult to make cuts anywhere near the scale that Musk is talking about.
sentences.zh: 好的，总之，要在马斯克所说的规模上进行任何削减都非常困难。

sentences.en: Cutting the budget and even the size of the federal workforce will be very hard.
sentences.zh: 削减预算，甚至削减联邦工作人员的规模，都将非常困难。

sentences.en: But what about this idea of reducing government regulation?
sentences.zh: 但是，减少政府监管这个想法又如何呢？

sentences.en: This is clearly what animates Musk.
sentences.zh: 这显然是马斯克所热衷的。

sentences.en: That's what got Musk into this.
sentences.zh: 这就是马斯克参与进来的原因。

sentences.en: He runs a lot of businesses that are regulated by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他经营着许多受联邦政府监管的企业。

sentences.en: He regards a lot of those regulations as standing in his way, standing in the way of progress.
sentences.zh: 他认为许多此类法规阻碍了他，阻碍了进步。

sentences.en: He often says standing in the way of getting humanity to Mars.
sentences.zh: 他经常说这阻碍了人类前往火星。

sentences.en: And when he talks about, you know, what will this Doge committee do?
sentences.zh: 当他谈到，你知道，这个“Doge”委员会将做什么时？

sentences.en: He often talks about things that affect him personally.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈论那些对他个人有影响的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I'd like to get rid of this regulation that slows down my rocket launches or that inhibits this tunnel I'm digging somewhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想摆脱这个减慢我火箭发射速度的法规，或者阻碍我在某处挖掘隧道的法规。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm not saying that he gets into this only to sort of clear the way for his businesses.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我并不是说他参与进来只是为了给他的企业扫清障碍。

sentences.en: But when he talks about what makes him mad about government and why he's so animated about this, it's clearly the regulations that impact him.
sentences.zh: 但当他谈到政府的什么让他生气，以及为什么他对此如此热衷时，显然是那些影响他的法规。

sentences.en: So that makes sense for him to say regulations is the place we're going to start.
sentences.zh: 所以对他来说，说监管是我们开始的地方是有道理的。

sentences.en: So remember that so much of their plan revolves around using this court case that ended what we called Chevron deference.
sentences.zh: 记住，他们的计划很大程度上围绕着利用那个结束了我们所谓的“雪佛龙尊重原则”（Chevron deference）的法院判决。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so their argument here is that now there's all this new power in the executive branch to basically stop enforcing rules you don't agree with.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的论点是，现在行政部门拥有了所有这些新的权力，基本上可以停止执行你不同意的规则。

sentences.en: But the problem with that argument is that, according to the legal experts we've talked to, is it is 100% wrong.
sentences.zh: 但这个论点的问题在于，根据我们采访过的法律专家的说法，它是100%错误的。

sentences.en: Okay, how?
sentences.zh: 好的，怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, remember that the essence of that decision was it took power that had been given to the executive branch, the federal agencies, and gave it to the courts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，记住那个判决的本质是，它收回了赋予行政部门（联邦机构）的权力，并将其交给了法院。

sentences.en: The courts now have the power to strike down these regulations if they feel like they have overstepped the bounds.
sentences.zh: 法院现在有权在认为这些法规越界时将其废除。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they don't have to defer to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不必尊重联邦政府的意见。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It doesn't do anything to say that the federal executive branch can decide to do that.
sentences.zh: 说联邦行政部门可以决定这样做是毫无根据的。

sentences.en: In fact, it takes power away from them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这剥夺了他们的权力。

sentences.en: So basically, they're claiming a right and a power not to enforce regulations that is nowhere in that court decision.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们声称拥有不执行法规的权利和权力，而这在那个法院判决中根本不存在。

sentences.en: And in fact, they probably have less power to ignore rules or reinterpret rules than they did before because that power is now in the courts.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们忽视规则或重新解释规则的权力可能比以前更小了，因为这种权力现在掌握在法院手中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I do think that that court case will lead to a lot more deregulation, but it's going to happen slowly.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为那个法院判决会导致更多的去监管化，但这会发生得很慢。

sentences.en: One court case at a time is court sort of roll back those rules.
sentences.zh: 法院会一个案子一个案子地撤销这些规则。

sentences.en: It's not going to happen all at once because the president decides he doesn't want to start enforcing rules he doesn't like.
sentences.zh: 这不会因为总统决定他不想执行他不喜欢的规则而一次性发生。

sentences.en: So their central argument of how they're going to pull off this efficiency thing kind of doesn't hold water.
sentences.zh: 所以他们关于如何实现这种效率的核心论点有点站不住脚。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They have lofty ambitions.
sentences.zh: 他们有崇高的抱负。

sentences.en: They have a lot of confidence and they have some very high level ideas about what they want to cut.
sentences.zh: 他们非常有信心，并且对他们想要削减的内容有一些非常高层级的想法。

sentences.en: But this is not something that can be done with high level ideas.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是仅靠高层级的想法就能完成的事情。

sentences.en: This is going to take a lot of detailed, focused effort, a lot of political effort.
sentences.zh: 这需要大量详细、专注的努力，以及大量的政治努力。

sentences.en: And we haven't seen yet that those elements are present.
sentences.zh: 而我们目前还没有看到这些要素的存在。

sentences.en: And of course, do they even agree among themselves on all of this stuff?
sentences.zh: 当然，他们自己对所有这些事情达成一致了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, as you've described here, it doesn't sound like they're all going to be rowing in the same direction.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你在这里所描述的，听起来他们并不会齐心协力。

sentences.en: Look, I think the most important thing to remember about all this is the finite quality of all this is going to be attention and energy.
sentences.zh: 看，我认为关于这一切最重要的一点是，所有这些的有限性将在于注意力和精力。

sentences.en: Both Musk's energy, Ramaswamy's energy, probably most importantly, Donald Trump's energy.
sentences.zh: 马斯克的精力、拉马斯瓦米的精力，可能最重要的是，唐纳德·特朗普的精力。

sentences.en: Remember, when Trump takes office, he's promised to do all kinds of things that are going to be disruptive in Washington.
sentences.zh: 记住，当特朗普上任时，他承诺要做各种各样会扰乱华盛顿的事情。

sentences.en: They're going to produce controversy and they're going to take energy, time and effort to make work.
sentences.zh: 这些事情会引发争议，并且需要精力、时间和努力才能奏效。

sentences.en: He's talked about mass deportations, a deportation like we haven't seen in decades.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了大规模驱逐出境，这种驱逐是我们几十年来未曾见过的。

sentences.en: He's talked about tariffs, huge tariffs on a lot of different countries and possibly trade deals.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了关税，对许多不同国家征收巨额关税，以及可能的贸易协议。

sentences.en: There's a lot of disruption he's promised.
sentences.zh: 他承诺了很多破坏性的举措。

sentences.en: And in among all this, Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy are going to try to make a very disruptive change in the size of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切之中，埃隆·马斯克和维韦克·拉马斯瓦米将试图对联邦政府的规模进行非常具有破坏性的改变。

sentences.en: The question for me is when the rubber hits the road on these cuts, when they recommend big cuts to different agencies or to things that congressmen want to fight for, is Trump
sentences.zh: 对我来说，问题在于当这些削减措施真正落实时，当他们建议对不同机构或国会议员想要争取的项目进行大幅削减时，特朗普

sentences.en: going to have the energy and the inclination to join that fight, to lend him some of his presidential energy and power?
sentences.zh: 是否有精力和意愿加入这场斗争，借给他们一些他的总统精力和权力？

sentences.en: Or is he going to be focused on other things?
sentences.zh: 还是他会专注于其他事情？

sentences.en: But as you said, we do have a budget deficit crisis.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，我们确实面临预算赤字危机。

sentences.en: The country could benefit from addressing it.
sentences.zh: 国家如果能解决这个问题将受益匪浅。

sentences.en: This is a hugely important conversation.
sentences.zh: 这是一场极其重要的对话。

sentences.en: Just in the last few years, we've added $12 trillion to the national debt.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几年里，我们的国债增加了12万亿美元。

sentences.en: We spend, as I said, more than 10% of the federal budget every year just paying off the debt for money we already borrowed.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们每年花费联邦预算的10%以上，仅仅是为了偿还我们已经借入资金的债务。

sentences.en: Whatever you think the size of the federal budget ought to be, I think the country would
sentences.zh: 无论你认为联邦预算的规模应该是多少，我认为国家都会

sentences.en: benefit from a real serious, significant conversation about what it spends money on and an effort to
sentences.zh: 从一场真正严肃、重大的关于政府开支的对话中受益，并努力

sentences.en: try to make that more efficient, to try to spend the least you can to get the services you want.
sentences.zh: 尝试提高效率，尝试以最低成本获得你想要的服务。

sentences.en: So given all of that, David, what's the best case scenario here?
sentences.zh: 那么考虑到所有这些，大卫，这里最好的情况是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, in terms of what Doge might actually get done?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就“Doge”实际上可能完成的事情而言？

sentences.en: I think the best case scenario is that Elon Musk really dives into one of these really thorny, ugly, complicated federal government bureaucracies and finds a way to make it more
sentences.zh: 我认为最好的情况是，埃隆·马斯克真正深入研究这些棘手、丑陋、复杂的联邦政府官僚机构之一，并找到一种方法使其更

sentences.en: efficient.
sentences.zh: 有效率。

sentences.en: Think about finding waste in Medicare, where there's billions of dollars lost to waste.
sentences.zh: 想想在医疗保险（Medicare）中寻找浪费，那里有数十亿美元因浪费而流失。

sentences.en: Think about auditing the Pentagon, although the Pentagon is one of its customers.
sentences.zh: 想想审计五角大楼，尽管五角大楼是它的客户之一。

sentences.en: But if there was a way to shrink the wasted money and duplication at the Pentagon, you could really make a huge difference, not just in the budget, but at the functioning of the
sentences.zh: 但如果有一种方法可以减少五角大楼的浪费资金和重复建设，你真的可以产生巨大的影响，不仅是在预算上，而且是在

sentences.en: federal government.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府的运作上。

sentences.en: I think that's the best case scenario is that someone really digs into one of these supposedly unsolvable problems that make the government so big and inefficient.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是最好的情况，即有人真正深入研究这些据称无法解决的问题，正是这些问题使政府变得如此庞大和低效。

sentences.en: But the worst case scenario here is that Trump or Musk get distracted.
sentences.zh: 但最坏的情况是，特朗普或马斯克分心了。

sentences.en: They get bogged down.
sentences.zh: 他们陷入了困境。

sentences.en: They don't change very much.
sentences.zh: 他们没有做出太大的改变。

sentences.en: But the small things they do change, they make a huge deal out of.
sentences.zh: 但他们所做的那些小改变，却被他们大肆宣扬。

sentences.en: And people see that, see, you know, a cut of a few million dollars here, even a few billion dollars here, things that sound big but are actually pretty small in the context of the

sentences.en: federal government, that they see those kind of changes and they think, oh, the problem was fixed.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了这些变化，就认为，哦，问题解决了。

sentences.en: Donald Trump fixed this problem, when in reality, the problem wasn't fixed.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普解决了这个问题，而实际上，问题并没有解决。

sentences.en: It was just sort of kicked down the road for somebody else to deal with.
sentences.zh: 它只是被推迟了，留给别人去处理。

sentences.en: In other words, this just becomes another chapter in the government's struggle to contain the problem.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这只是政府在遏制该问题斗争中的又一个篇章。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: South Korea, one of America's closest allies in Asia, descended into political chaos on
sentences.zh: 韩国，美国在亚洲最亲密的盟友之一，在周二陷入了政治混乱，

sentences.en: Tuesday after its president, Yoon Suk-yeol, imposed martial law.
sentences.zh: 此前其总统尹锡悦实施了戒严令。

sentences.en: And then, just hours later, the country's National Assembly, in a swift rebuke to the president, voted to lift it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几个小时后，该国国民议会迅速反击总统，投票解除了戒严。

sentences.en: Yoon, a deeply unpopular and divisive leader, accused the opposition of, quote, trying to overthrow democracy.
sentences.zh: 尹锡悦是一位极不受欢迎且具有分裂性的领导人，他指责反对派“试图推翻民主”。

sentences.en: It was the first time a South Korean president had declared martial law since the military dictatorship ended in the country in the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这是自20世纪80年代末该国军事独裁统治结束以来，韩国总统首次宣布戒严。

sentences.en: The move drew peaceful protests in Seoul, the capital, and over the course of a tense night, eventually backfired.
sentences.zh: 此举在首都首尔引发了和平抗议，经过一个紧张的夜晚，最终适得其反。

sentences.en: Before the sun rose on Wednesday morning, the president had backed down and rescinded his martial law declaration.
sentences.zh: 在周三清晨太阳升起之前，总统已经退缩并撤销了他的戒严令。

sentences.en: And, Donald Trump's transition team announced that it had belatedly signed an agreement with

sentences.en: the Department of Justice that will allow the FBI to conduct background checks on people

sentences.en: Trump intends to appoint as senior officials in his new administration.
